effect_description_eng: ＜Decoy ([Puppet] trait)＞ (When your other [Puppet] trait Digimon would be deleted by an opponent's effect, you may delete this Digimon to prevent 1 of those Digimon's deletion.)
inherited_effect_description_eng: ＜Barrier＞ (When this Digimon would be deleted in battle, by trashing the top card of your security stack, prevent that deletion.)
